ROOT.glyph: A heavy filled square sits low and centred, its lower edge flat and unbroken: the earth foundation, grounded and belonging, dense as stone weight. Down from the square's underside a single thick bar descends straight and stops abruptly, cut off: the buried part that continues unseen. Two short parallel bars stand upright beneath, apart from the descender and from each other, planted like legs that hold their ground. Above the square, a hollow circle rests just clear of its top edge, open and unbroken: the quiet hum below made into a steady containment, safety held in a ring. From the circle's upper-left a thin line lifts and thins away, the faint reach upward toward the next gate. To the square's right, a small solid dot floats alone at mid-height, red earth remembered as a single weight. Everything sits slightly left of true centre, a deliberate tilt toward the ground.

SACRAL.glyph: A broad crescent, open upward and tilted a few degrees, sits low and central, drawn as a thick closed band with a hollow interior: the womb and the birthing tide, holding what is to come. Inside the hollow, resting at the lowest point, a single solid dot, small and round: pleasure, the seed of making. Above the crescent's left horn a short vertical bar stands apart, solid and heavy: the fixed and rooted that this centre turns from. From the right horn a long thin line rises in three shallow waves, thinning as it climbs: the honeyed water, the flowing that rises and leaves. A second, shorter open curve floats just above the waves, echoing their rhythm without touching them: the sensual, repeated but never held. The crescent and its dot form the dense centre; the bar and the rippling line oppose each other at either side, one still, one moving, and the composition leans gently toward the moving side.

SOLAR PLEXUS.glyph: A dense filled circle sits just above the centre, held tight, the core of will and gut knowing. Ten short bars radiate outward from it at even spacing but stop well short, leaving a clear gap: radiance that reaches but does not scatter, boundaries kept. Around the core, a broken ring of four thick arcs opens at the diagonals, the fire in the belly pressing at its seams. A single thin line runs down from the circle's underside and ends in a small hollow disc below: digestion drawing down, what is taken in. To the right of the ring, one arc is separated and displaced outward, the moment of breaking open.

HEART.glyph: A hollow open ring sits exactly at the centre, its stroke even and unbroken: the middle, the heart chakra's still point, held and continuous. Passing straight through the ring, two thin lines run vertically, one entering from above and one from below, meeting inside the hollow without touching its rim: the balance of what descends and what rises. Above the ring, two open curves lift outward and away from each other, mirrored and not joined, thinning as they rise: the wings and the air element released upward. Below the ring, two open curves bend down and outward in the same mirrored way, heavier in stroke and shorter, weighted: grief held gently and drawn downward. Between the upper curves, a single small filled dot floats apart from everything, the only solid mass: compassion given freely, unattached. The whole tilts very slightly to one side, so the vertical lines lean together at the top and part at the bottom, keeping the emblem from perfect symmetry.

THROAT.glyph: A vertical hollow channel runs down the centre: two long parallel lines, slightly bowed apart at the middle and closing toward each other at top and bottom, the passage that must stay open. Across its middle sits one solid black bar, wider than the channel, crossing both lines: the tightness that blocks the voice. Below the bar the channel opens into a shallow cup of two diverging strokes that never meet, what is let out and spoken. Above the bar, three short horizontal bars stack in the gap between the lines, evenly spaced and thinning upward, the rhythm of humming and song rising. A single small filled dot floats just outside the right line near the top, apart and unfixed: the clarity that arrives when the passage is clear. The whole tilts very slightly left, so nothing sits perfectly at ease.

THIRD EYE.glyph: A single solid black diamond, taller than wide, sits at the exact centre, its four points sharp: the compressed core of inner seeing, held and closed. A second diamond outline, hollow and slightly larger, encloses it with an even gap, the veil that stays just apart from what it guards. Two short thick bars run vertically on either side of the outer diamond, level with its widest point, like the brows pressing; they do not touch the diamond and are the same length. Above the outer diamond's top point, a single thin line rises and ends in a small open circle, the pressure reaching upward, connected but unfilled. Below the outer diamond's bottom point, three fine parallel strokes descend, evenly spaced and shortening as they go, light thinning out downward. The left brow bar is placed a little higher than the right, so the whole composition tilts faintly: the witness is not quite level with the world.

CROWN.glyph: A large open ring sits high in the composition, its lower arc broken by a wide gap, so the form is a vessel that never closes: the opening skyward and the dissolving edge. Inside the gap, a small solid dot floats free, not touching either end, the weightless point of union. Above the ring, five thin vertical strokes rise at even spacing, tallest in the middle, thinning to nothing at their tips: the thousand petals let out, silence thinning out. Below the ring, a single heavy horizontal bar spans slightly wider than the ring, its ends turned down in short stubs: the ground of the body held beneath, dense against the thin strokes above. From the centre of the bar, one thin continuous line rises and stops short of the floating dot, reaching toward grace without meeting it.
